dialogs.about: 놀러 온 손녀에게 집 구석구석을 보여줘요

lines.en: Welcome, dear. This is our old apartment.
lines.ko: 어서 와요. 여기가 우리 오래된 아파트예요.

lines.en: It's very nice. Where do the stairs go?
lines.ko: 아주 좋아요. 이 계단은 어디로 가요?

lines.en: They go upstairs to the attic.
Can I see the attic, Grandma?
Of course. We cleaned it last week.
The ceiling is so low up here!
Yes. Your father played here long ago.
What is in the basement, Grandma?
Old boxes. I will show you tomorrow.
Thank you, Grandma. I like this house.

dialogs.about: 아파트 복도에서 이웃과 마당 이야기를 나눠요

lines.en: Good morning! Did you sweep the hallway?
Yes, I swept it this morning.
Thank you. The stairs were dirty yesterday.
I know. Is your car in the garage?
Yes. I am going to wash it later.
Our yard has many flowers now.
Can I see them after lunch?
Of course. Please come to the balcony.
Is your balcony upstairs?
Yes, it is upstairs. See you soon.
